# Dang Pham — Visual / Digital Designer

> Visual and Digital Designer in Ho Chi Minh City working across digital visual design, web and product UI, motion, icon systems, 3D illustration and independent AI image/video workflows.

## Portfolio
- [Selected work and professional experience](/)
- [Full work archive](/work)

## Independent Projects
- [WWM Build Lab](/projects/wwm-build-lab) — gear and combat calculator with evidence-aware data states, reproducible calculation context and production verification.
- [Thiên Kim](/projects/thien-kim) — virtual-character art direction and repeatable AI image/video workflow covering continuity, shot planning, execution routing and QC.
- [WWM Homestead Planner](/projects/wwm-homestead) — production, profit, material-runway and retainer planning tool with dashboards and constraint-aware recommendations.

## Capabilities
- Visual & Graphic: digital/web visual design, graphic design, typography/layout, cross-format adaptation.
- Product & Web: Figma, responsive UI, landing pages, design systems.
- Motion & 3D: After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, UI motion and 3D animation.
- AI Image & Video: character-consistency workflows, image-to-video direction, short-form shot planning, AI-assisted creative production.

## Source Policy
Public visual work is linked to the original Dribbble source where available. Independent projects link to live products, repositories or published output. The portfolio avoids invented client names, campaign outcomes, KPIs and unverified performance claims.
